scenarios.title: {tyler} Gets Cut
scenarios.text: {tyler} is released on a Monday. He calls you before his agent.

choices.label: Listen
choices.result: You listen for an hour. He doesn't want advice, and you don't give any.

choices.label: Make a call for him
choices.result: You call a special teams coach you know and say his name.

choices.label: Send a message
choices.result: You send a message and a promise to talk soon.

scenarios.title: The Holder's Last Season
scenarios.text: {holder} is retiring after this season and wants every hold to count.

choices.label: Make it a season to remember
choices.result: You make every practice a little celebration with {holder}.

choices.label: Make it count on the field
choices.result: You make every kick count for {holder}, practicing like it's the playoffs.

choices.label: Help pick the next holder
choices.result: You help {holder} train the next holder, so the job is in good hands.

scenarios.title: The Concussion
scenarios.text: A teammate who has had too many concussions takes another hit in practice and hides it. You saw it happen, and he saw you see it.

choices.label: Tell the trainers
choices.result: You tell the trainers before the next drill. He's angry for a week and won't look at you, then thanks you in the parking lot.

choices.label: Talk to him first
choices.result: You talk to him first, away from everyone, and convince him to tell the trainers himself. It costs you an hour and some of his pride.

choices.label: Stay out of it
choices.result: You stay out of it. He plays the next game, and you watch him every snap, wondering.

scenarios.title: A College Teammate's Wedding
scenarios.text: Your old college roommate is getting married, and he wants you to give a toast.

choices.label: Write a great toast
choices.result: You write a great toast and deliver it from memory. The bride's grandmother hugs you.

choices.label: Tell one true story
choices.result: You tell one true story from freshman year. It's the one people repeat at breakfast.

choices.label: Remember the pact
choices.result: You raise a glass to the pact you made freshman year. He laughs so hard he can't finish his drink.
choices.lock_text: having made a pact with your college roommate

choices.label: Make peace in the toast
choices.result: You haven't really talked since college. You say so in the toast, and you say sorry. He finds you on the patio afterward.
choices.lock_text: having fallen out with your college roommate

scenarios.title: The Snapper Retires
scenarios.text: The long snapper you've trusted for years is done, and he asks you to speak at his farewell.

choices.label: Speak from the heart
choices.result: You tell the room what it's like to trust someone without ever looking. He cries first.

choices.label: Keep it light
choices.result: You tell three funny stories and one true one. The room loves it.

choices.label: Say a few words
choices.result: You say a few words and raise a glass of water. He hugs you anyway.

scenarios.title: The Veteran Who Can't Let Go
scenarios.text: A thirty-six-year-old linebacker is getting cut, and he hasn't figured it out yet.

choices.label: Sit with him
choices.result: You sit with him at lunch on his last day. He talks about his first season.

choices.label: Tell the young players
choices.result: You tell the young players to say goodbye before he's gone.

choices.label: Let it happen
choices.result: You let it happen. It's not your place, and it stays with you.

scenarios.title: The Players-Only Meeting
scenarios.text: The team captains call a players-only meeting about the coach, and they want your vote.

choices.label: Speak honestly
choices.result: You speak honestly: the coach is tough and fair. Some agree, some don't.

choices.label: Ask for facts
choices.result: You ask what exactly the problem is before voting. The meeting gets calmer.

choices.label: Abstain
choices.result: You abstain. Kickers rarely get asked anyway.

scenarios.title: The Player Rep
scenarios.text: The team needs a union representative, and nobody wants to be the one management remembers.

choices.label: Volunteer
choices.result: You volunteer. It's meetings and calls, and the young players start coming to you.

choices.label: Nominate the right person
choices.result: You nominate the veteran who should do it. He accepts, grumbling.

choices.label: Stay out of it
choices.result: You stay out of it. Someone else does it.

scenarios.title: The Injured Teammate
scenarios.text: A teammate who tore his knee for the team is cut the day he's cleared to practice.

choices.label: Help him clean out
choices.result: You help him clean out his locker. He doesn't say much.

choices.label: Say something to the room
choices.result: You say something to the room about how this business works. The young players listen.

choices.label: Keep quiet
choices.result: You keep quiet. You're one bad season from the same thing.

scenarios.title: The Podcast
scenarios.text: A popular podcast wants you for an hour. The host is known for getting athletes to say too much.

choices.label: Prepare and stay disciplined
choices.result: You prepare and stay disciplined. It's a good episode with no headlines.

choices.label: Be yourself
choices.result: You're funny and honest. One joke about a teammate gets clipped everywhere.

choices.label: Decline
choices.result: You decline. The host says something snide about kickers on the next episode.

scenarios.title: The National Deal
scenarios.text: A national brand wants you for a commercial that would play during every game this year.

choices.label: Take it
choices.result: You sign on. You're everywhere, and the shoot eats your bye week.

choices.label: Negotiate the schedule
choices.result: You agree if they shoot in the offseason. They do.

choices.label: Pass
choices.result: You pass. You'd rather be known for kicking.

scenarios.title: The Leak
scenarios.text: Someone is leaking locker-room conversations to a reporter, and the coaches think it's a specialist.

choices.label: Help find the leak
choices.result: You notice which details leak and tell {coach} what they have in common. It's a rookie lineman.

choices.label: Talk to the specialists
choices.result: You talk to the specialists and make sure everyone knows what's at stake.

choices.label: Stay out of it
choices.result: You stay out of it and let the coaches sort it out.

scenarios.title: The Prime Slump
scenarios.text: You're supposed to be at your best, and the misses in practice have started making headlines. The coaches haven't said anything, which is worse.

choices.label: Go back to the film
choices.result: You go back to the film of your best season and find the one thing that changed: your plant foot drifted half an inch. It takes a week to fix.

choices.label: Kick through it
choices.result: You kick through it, two hundred extra balls a day. Your leg aches, your rhythm comes back, and nobody can say you didn't work.

choices.label: Lean on the holder
choices.result: You and {holder} go back to basics together, laughing at how far you've come. It helps more than you expected.

choices.label: Use the tools you learned
choices.result: You use the tools you learned the last time this happened. It's shorter this time.
